newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Jadeite auction sees new record - Christie's.
newsitem.headline: Jadeite auction sees new record - Christie's.

text.p: Bidders swamped a jadeite auction in Hong Kong to pay out a total of HK$133.124 million (US$17.2 million), including a record HK$13.22 million for a pair of earrings, Christie's said on Wednesday.
A pair of jadeite double hoop and diamond pendant earrings sold for HK$13.22 million at the jewellery auction on Tuesday, a world record for jadeite earrings, it said.
"The saleroom was packed with collectors and dealers in a frenzy of activity not seen since the height of the market more than seven years ago," Christie's said in a statement.
It said its spring auctions in Hong Kong brought in HK$316.293 million, its highest total in a season in the territory.
